questions.q_en: In the following question, four words have been given out of which three are alike in some manner, while one word is different. Select the word which is different.
questions.solution_en:
Geologist is a person who is expert in geology (i.e., study related to rocks).

Psychologist is a person who studies the mind and the way that people behave.

Environmentalist is a person who is expert on environmental problems.

Archeologist is a person who is expert in archeology (i.e., study of the past, based on objects or parts of building found in the ground).

Thus, geologist, environmentalist and archeologist are related to the environmental studies.

questions.q_en: Select the word-pair in which the two words share a different relationship from that shared by the two words in the rest of the word-pairs.
questions.solution_en:
Let's analyze the relationships between the word pairs:

Option (a): Assign: Allot

In this pair, both words are synonyms and share a similar relationship of "allocating" or "giving."

Option (b): Solicit: Request In this pair, both words are synonyms and share a similar relationship of "asking for" or "seeking."

Option (c): Fallacy: Illusion In this pair, both words synonyms and share a similar relationship of mistaken belief or a misleading argument.

Option (d): Initial: Final In this pair, both words are antonyms and share a contrasting relationship. "Initial" means the beginning or starting point, while "Final" means the end or concluding point.

Hence, option (d) is correct.
